from tenacity import retry_if_exception_type, retry_any, retry_all


def test_bug():
    r1 = retry_if_exception_type(ValueError)
    r2 = retry_if_exception_type(TypeError)
    r3 = retry_if_exception_type(KeyError)

    combined = r1 | r2 | r3
    assert isinstance(combined, retry_any)
    assert len(combined.retries) == 3

    combined_all = r1 & r2 & r3
    assert isinstance(combined_all, retry_all)
    assert len(combined_all.retries) == 3
